title: The deep's palette (B4): before and after
lede: Main against the B4 build: the whole deep on 6 greys and 5 purples, flat props lit purple, one flat water. Not on main yet: approve to land it.
head: e243c0a0538de36f6f723a8db4c9402e38c0ce2f

items.title: Props and domes flat, lit purple along their tops
items.what: Every station's prop and dome is one flat tone; their top edges breathe purple. Floor and plinth flat.

items.title: One flat dark water; purple stars and silt are the only texture
items.what: The dithered zones and the flowing veil are gone; the water is one grey, lit by purple stars and drifting purple silt.

items.title: The portal still reads as a hole
items.what: The water is the one kept grey above black, so the portal's black mouth stands out from it.

items.title: Creatures and the stream drawn flat, never darker than the water
items.what: Zone creatures and the stream are flat tones from the capped palette; the far stream never sinks below the water.

items.title: The serpent fight on the capped palette
items.what: Body, cage, cracks, statuses, the bar and the fight numbers all on the deep's 6 greys and 5 purples; status names smoothed only in the deep's greys.

items.title: The near-death and power-up on the capped palette
items.what: The cracks, the light, the rays and the motes step through the kept tones; the rays read as light, not bars.

items.title: Furnace, pods and a station going up
items.what: Flat silhouettes with breathing purple tops; the furnace keeps its brick in two tones.

items.title: The kill, him freed, the finale's deep part, endless
items.what: The cutscenes fade by stepping toward the water instead of a wash; the letterbox rule moved to the lit grey.

items.title: Side effect in the yard: bodies and glyph stacks snap to whole pixels
items.what: Snapping to whole device pixels makes the yard's bodies and the glyph stacks over stations slightly crisper.
